# Shared service defaults
defaults: &defaults
  retries: 3
  labels: [core,api]
  health: !endpoint {path: /health, method: GET} # custom-tagged flow
services:
  - &api
    name: api
    <<: *defaults
    ports: [80,443] # preserve trailing comment
  - name: worker
    <<: *defaults
    depends_on: [*api]
templates:
  tagged: !service &template {name: base, enabled:true}
  alias: *template
notes: &notes !markdown |
  #   Anchored Note

  See   alias.
reference: *notes
